item.title: ▶ The Dream Phone Is Here!...
item.dc:creator: Beebom · Instagram
item.description:
The Dream Phone Is Here!

🔗Link In Bio!

In this video, we are talking about a small phone with swappable keypads that can do things most phones cannot.

It is tiny and easy to hold. It runs Android, so you can use your apps and play games. It comes with the classic T9 keyboard.

Press and lift, and the keypad comes out, so you can replace it with multiple keypads.

The first is the Sundial, which makes the phone look like an iPod and is great for music lovers. It has all kinds of music controls, and all the keys are customisable.

The second is the Mini Controller keypad, which lets you play your favourite games with a controller feel.

The third is the Compact QWERTY keypad, which has more keys to type easily, for people who prefer texting to calling.

item.title: ▶ The Craziest Wireless Security Camera Ever!...
item.dc:creator: Beebom · Instagram
item.description:
The Craziest Wireless Security Camera Ever!

In this video, we are talking about the most useful wireless CCTV camera, which can be installed anywhere.

Peel the sticker and attach the mount on a window, a door, or anywhere you like. Insert the camera, turn it on, and you’re done. You get a completely wireless CCTV camera right on your window.

It has an anti-glare design, so the feed looks great even when the camera is placed behind the glass. It records a 120 degree wide view, and the camera output is excellent in the day time. For night time, you get full color night vision.

There is a microSD slot that stores the entire footage. The battery lasts up to one month, and you can charge it with Type-C.

There’s app support, and it has a live view and also supports two-way audio.

item.title: ▶ WhatsApp Message Scheduling Is Finally Here!...
item.dc:creator: Beebom · Instagram
item.description:
WhatsApp Message Scheduling Is Finally Here!

In this video, we are talking about the most requested WhatsApp feature, scheduled messages!

Open WhatsApp, type anything in a chat, and press and hold the send button. A new option comes up that lets you schedule the message for later.

You can schedule all kinds of messages in any chat, up to 14 days in advance. You can use it for birthday wishes, anniversary wishes, or reminders for your friends. You can schedule photos and videos too.

The messages are still delivered on time even if your phone is switched off.

item.title: ▶ The Craziest Smart Safe For Your Valuables! ...
item.dc:creator: Beebom · Instagram
item.description:
The Craziest Smart Safe For Your Valuables!

In this video, we are talking about a gadget that hides your most valuable things, and nobody can break into it.

It looks like a normal bedside desk gadget, with an always on clock, alarms, and other features that make it look like a desk clock. There is a MagSafe phone charger on top. But it is actually a solid, unbreakable safe.

It is made of 18 gauge steel, so even an axe can do no damage. The lock has an anti impact and break proof structure, so nobody can force it open.

You can unlock it with your fingerprint, and you can save up to 30 different fingerprints. You can also use a 6 digit PIN. If someone enters the wrong PIN 5 times, it instantly locks again. There is also a physical key at the back, so you have more than one option.

When you unlock it, the drawer opens automatically. There is padding inside and an LED light, so you can find things easily even at night.

To power it, you can use the adapter, regular batteries, or the Type-C port for emergency unlock.

item.title: ▶ The MOST USEFUL PS5 Gadget! 🤯...
item.dc:creator: Beebom · Instagram
item.description:
The MOST USEFUL PS5 Gadget! 🤯

In this video, we are talking about a PS5 gadget for when your controller dies in the middle of a game.

Just attach it to your controller and press the button. It starts charging your controller, so you can keep playing completely wirelessly.

It has a 1600mAh battery, which gives you double the play time. It weighs just 75 grams, so you don’t have to worry about your port or any extra weight. It also supports bypass charging, so you can keep it on all the time.

item.title: ▶ The Magic Pen From The Future!...
item.dc:creator: Beebom · Instagram
item.description:
The Magic Pen From The Future!

In this video, we are talking about a pen with a built-in screen that can scan text and show you the answer.

Press the pen on a question and move it straight, and the screen displays the answer to the question.

You can also move it over any text to scan and translate it, and it works offline too.

There is a camera on it, so you can click pictures of anything. All of them go straight to the gallery, and you can open the pictures and read everything you have clicked.

There is also a handwritten calculator built in. You can draw the problem on the screen, and the pen solves it for you.
